changelog: Unified Forge v0.5.12: ONE Forge box — type anything: if it exists, it spawns; if not, it's made for this match. Fixed 'weapon id missing' — installed mods (like the taquito launcher) now spawn from the Forge menu instead of being rejected. MAKE only fires as a fallback when Forge says 'Don't know'; refusals and validation errors never trigger a generation. Script mods now work in Loadouts via the same give path as Forge, including a script mod in the secondary slot without clobbering primary. Longest-match name resolution — 'give me the taquito launcher script' now finds the script mod, not the JSON one.
